text.description_html:
High Security Lock Cylinder for Schlage F-Series Door Knobs

This lock cylinder fits all Schlage F-Series Door Knobs. Does NOT fit Door Levers, only the door Knobs.

High security Mul-T-Lock lock cylinders are designed with pick and drill resistance. Hardened steel inserts are strategically placed in sensitive areas to resist against drilling attempts. Specific parts are reinforced with some of the strongest materials available to resist tampering and forced entry.

Supplied standard with 1 owner key card and 2 keys per cylinder. MUL-T-LOCK's cylindrical locks are designed to provide superior door protection with uncompromised key control. The Key Card owner is the person allowed to have the keys duplicated.

Features for Mul-T-Lock 206S-KIKSHFL Lock Cylinder

  • Drill and Pick Resistance Lock Cylinder
  • Bump Proof Design
  • Mul-T-Lock 206S Plus Security Keyway
  • 2 Keys per Lock
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • For Schlage F-Series Door Knobs

If ordering multiple locks you can have them Key Alike (use the same key) or Keyed Different (different keys for each lock). You can also order Extra Mul-T-Lock Keys if more than 2 are required.
